meta_description: 14K likes, 102 comments - milindrunning on September 22, 2026: "Yaaaaay!!! Finished another full Ironman together ❤️ We had planned to do Wales together as well, but Ankita’s fall from her bike on a steep descent during a practise session and subsequent injuries didn’t allow her to finish the tough course. Six days after Ironman Wales, she smashed her second Ironman again in Emilia Romagna, Italy! So so proud of your resilience, and how you picked yourself up and came back so strong my love 🤗 here’s to many more fun times together !! And yes...the Dragon will be waiting !!!!!".
